facts_raw.Notes: Elite medtech founder-pipeline fellowship. International applicants explicitly supported; 12 fellows selected annually.

facts.Focus: Medtech, diagnostics, digital health, drug delivery, biotech
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Individual application for healthcare, engineering, computing, design or business backgrounds. Requires lawful US work through an academic visa, English proficiency and three recommendations.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Healthtech or research experience, leadership, problem solving, creativity, teamwork and communication.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Full-time at Stanford for approximately ten months, exceeding 40 hours weekly; outside work is not permitted.
facts.International Founder: Yes, non-US citizens encouraged, subject to visa rules
facts.Visa / Relocation: Stanford may use an academic visa pathway, but does not sponsor H-1B visas. Current policy may restrict some nationalities.
facts.Deadline / Next Intake: Deadline was Aug 27, 2026; next cycle later
facts.Application Materials: Complete application, education and career history, essays, two-minute video and three recommendations; TOEFL or IELTS if required.
facts.Public Contact Route: Official fellowship or Stay in Touch form; walk-in visits are not accepted.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: MedTech / Health / Bio; primarily at the Individual innovator / pre-company stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses; Established companies with a settled team and business model seeking funding only
facts.Notes: Elite medtech founder-pipeline fellowship. International applicants explicitly supported; 12 fellows selected annually.
